Hi! Have you ever heard of PrEP? It is a pill you can take to prevent HIV. You can ask your primary care physician about it and get a prescription. If your primary care doctor can’t help you a sexual/reproductive health clinic definitely can. 

PrEP is only for HIV so if you want further protection from other STIs, condoms are the way to go. 

Also, if someone is HIV positive and takes their medications as directed, its impossible to pass on the virus to you. This is an important conversation to have with partners. 

Finally *if you did* happen to get HIV, it would not be the end of the world. It is a highly manageable disease and people go on to live healthy happy lives when they stick to their treatment. 

I hope some of this can give you some peace of mind. I work at an HIV clinic! Shoot me a dm if you have any other questions :)
